positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Software engineer responsible for the dynamic configuration, experimentation, and client logging framework in Product Instrumentation and Experimentation (PIE) team.  Prior to PIE team, led the Client Analytics team as a tech lead for the same systems.
- Implemented and maintained mobile configuration, experimentation and logging library for Android, as well as backend services.
- Designed and implemented thrift code generator (Scrooge) for Android, adopted to Twitter for Android app for client logging, and open sourced the project.
- Served as an engineering manager for International Growth team, focusing on new user experience and user growth products.
- Performed as a data scientist & software engineer in International Analytics team; provided user behavior and contents analysis of VIT users, and Twitter Translation Center.
- Java, Android, Thrift, Pig, Hadoop, Scala, Vertica, Javascript, Ruby
